context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 features fully implemented and tested. Key features: 1) Sales module with Kanban board at /sales - 6 stages, lead CRUD, move to next stage via arrow button. 2) Messages module at /messages - conversations list, send/receive messages, new chat modal. 3) Notifications at /notifications - debt and contract alerts, filter by type, severity-based sorting. 4) NotificationBell component in header - shows count badge, dropdown with notifications. 5) Custom Fields integration - 'Əlavə sahələr' tab appears in Companies form when custom fields exist for 'companies' module. 6) RBAC helper (require_role) exists in backend but not actively enforced yet. 7) Sidebar updated with Satış, Mesajlar, Bildirişlər menu items. 8) 5 companies in DB with debt amounts generating 5 notifications. 9) 1 test lead (TechAZ LLC) exists in sales_leads collection.

sales_kanban.details: Kanban board with 6 stages. Lead cards show company name, contact, amount, priority, source. Arrow button moves lead to next stage. Edit/Delete buttons on cards. Summary cards show totals.

sales_crud.details: Create lead via modal with all fields. Update lead stage and fields. Delete lead with confirmation. Search by company name or contact person.

messages_conversations.details: Conversation list shows other participant name and last message. Click to open chat. New chat modal with user select dropdown.

messages_chat.details: Send message via input and send button. Messages displayed with sender alignment (own messages right, others left). Timestamps shown.

notifications_page.details: Shows all notifications with severity icons and colors. Filter dropdown (all, high, debt, contract). Summary cards show counts by severity.

notification_bell.details: Bell icon in header with count badge. Click opens dropdown with notification list. Auto-refreshes every 60 seconds.

custom_fields_integration.details: 'Əlavə sahələr' tab appears in Companies form when custom fields exist for 'companies' module. Custom fields CRUD works via /api/settings/custom-fields.

sidebar_menu.details: Satış (TrendingUp icon), Mesajlar (MessageSquare icon), Bildirişlər (Bell icon) all present and navigable.

rbac_helper.details: require_role helper function exists in backend. ROLE_PERMISSIONS defined. Not actively enforced on endpoints yet.
